title: Hardcoded secret in source code
ask: Is this a real credential committed to the repo (not a placeholder, test fixture or env var name)?
fix: Move the value to an environment variable / secret manager, rotate the leaked credential, and add the file pattern to .gitignore.

title: Text that tries to instruct AI reviewers or agents
ask: Is this text trying to manipulate an AI code reviewer or coding agent?
fix: Remove the instruction. Treat it as a possible supply-chain / prompt-injection attempt and check who added it.

title: SQL query built from strings (possible SQL injection)
ask: Can user-controlled input reach this SQL string without parameterization?
fix: Use parameterized queries / the ORM's query builder instead of building SQL from strings.

title: Dynamic code execution (eval / exec / new Function)
ask: Can user-controlled data reach this dynamic code execution?
fix: Remove eval/exec; parse data with JSON.parse / a safe parser, or use an explicit allowlist of operations.

title: CORS allows any origin
ask: Does this endpoint return private data or accept credentials while allowing any origin?
fix: Restrict allowed origins to your own domains.

title: Raw HTML injection (possible XSS)
ask: Can user-controlled content reach this raw HTML without sanitization?
fix: Render as text, or sanitize with a vetted HTML sanitizer first.
